scoring_justification: Monte Carlo recompute is infeasible; structural audit verifies the trend (helicity modulus size‑dependence and boundary condition effect) that constitutes the paper's main claim.

outputs.description: Helicity modulus and heat capacity per site for XY-model on Sierpinski gaskets, used to assess absence of finite-temperature phase transition via size dependence of the helicity modulus at low temperature and the effect of boundary conditions.

output_contract.notes: Square lattice benchmark simulations, which were used for comparison in the paper, are not required for this reproduction; only Sierpinski gasket results are scored.

steps.description: Verify structural trends: helicity modulus decreasing with m for closed BC, near zero for open BC, and heat capacity size independence.
